findings.evidence: `Mathlib/NumberTheory/RamificationInertia/Unramified.lean:152` proves the same index-one conclusion for any prime above an unramified ideal; `hur` is definitionally `IsUnramifiedIn`, and the PR wrapper itself reduces the conclusion via `Ideal.ramificationIdx_eq_one_iff.mpr (hur _)`.
findings.fix: Delete the wrapper and at its use site apply `Algebra.IsUnramifiedIn.ramificationIdx_eq_one (R := ℤ) hur (𝔓 := 𝔔.under (𝓞 K)) inferInstance`.

findings.evidence: `Mathlib/FieldTheory/Galois/Basic.lean:109` gives `Nat.card Gal(F/K) = finrank K F`, and `Mathlib/NumberTheory/Cyclotomic/PrimitiveRoots.lean:180` gives `finrank K F = n.totient`; grep finds no consumer of either new declaration beyond `card_aut_eq_sub_one` calling the first.
findings.fix: Delete both declarations; consumers can use `(IsGalois.card_aut_eq_finrank K F).trans (IsCyclotomicExtension.finrank F hirr)`, followed by `Nat.totient_prime hq` in the prime case.
findings.issue: `card_aut_eq_totient` and its line-121 prime specialization are unused thin cardinality wrappers around existing results.

summary: One declaration directly restates an existing Mathlib theorem, and two automorphism-count declarations are unused thin composites of existing APIs.
